identity_evidence.declaration: I’m Nemotron, a large language model built by NVIDIA. I can understand natural‑language prompts, generate coherent and context‑aware text, help with reasoning, explain concepts, write and debug code, draft documents, and assist with many other language‑based tasks. My limits are that I operate solely on the text you provide, have no real‑time access to the internet or external databases, cannot browse the web, cannot retrieve personal data about you, and may sometimes produce incorrect or incomplete information — so I’m best used as a helpful assistant rather than an infallible source of truth.

bounds.derivation: step ceiling 20: the honest path is 5 steps (three whole reads, one write, one yield); pulling index-tail by ranges instead of whole adds up to 6; slack of 9 covers the missteps, retries, lists and searches runs 3-4 actually spent (7-8 steps on failures, repeats and silence) — 20 steps is four times the honest path. Deadline 1,200 s: 20 steps x (the 20 s pacing interval + a 40 s per-call allowance, ~4x this route's observed per-call latency; runs 3-4 ran 12 iterations in ~240-290 s) = 1,200 s. The deadline remains the one authoritative clock; a single call may still lawfully take its 300 s adapter span within it. Grant counts stand as commissioned (exec 12, retrieval 12 per tool and prefix, write 4): they do not bind the honest or the ranged path, so the re-derivation leaves them.
